Warnings array is empty for complex but valid HTML

```zig title="Zig"
const std = @import("std");
const html_to_markdown_rs = @import("html_to_markdown_rs");

pub fn main() !void {
    const _result_json = try html_to_markdown_rs.convert("<article><h1>Article</h1><p>Paragraph with <strong>bold</strong> and <em>italic</em>.</p><table><tr><th>Col</th></tr><tr><td>Val</td></tr></table><ul><li>Item 1</li><li>Item 2</li></ul></article>", null);
    defer std.heap.c_allocator.free(_result_json);
    std.debug.print("{s}\n", .{_result_json});

}
```
